title: The Shattered Mirror
description: An identity and shame arc. The traveler carries a mirror that shows only distortions — the false self built from others' projections. Breaking it reveals the true face underneath.

acts.title: The Hall of Reflections
acts.description: Everywhere the traveler looks, warped mirrors show a version of themselves shaped by someone else's words.

acts.title: The Shattering
acts.description: The traveler drops the mirror. In every shard, a different face — protector, exile, wounded child. All of them are real.

acts.title: The Still Pool
acts.description: At a quiet pool, the water shows not perfection but wholeness. Every scar visible. Every scar earned.
